content.title: How to watch Red Sox vs. Cardinals: TV channel and streaming options for April 11
content.text: The St. Louis Cardinals will aim to keep a three-game win streak going when they host the Boston Red Sox at 7:15 p.m. ET on Saturday. Ranger Suarez (0-1, 8.64 ERA) gets the start for the Red Sox, who are 4-9 this season and fifth in the AL East. Kyle Leahy (1-1, 5.40 ERA) is starting for the Cardinals, who are 8-5 and third in the NL Central.How to watch Boston Red Sox vs. St. Louis Cardinals Venue: Busch Stadium Time: 7:15 p.m. ET Streaming: Fubo (Stream now) TV: FOX Watching in person?
